**Daily Market Summary · 17 November 2026**

**Snapshot**
• Bitcoin is near $64,741, down about 12.3% over 7 days and about 21% over 30 days.
• Headline: **NEUTRAL** (medium confidence). Fear & Greed is 12, extreme fear.
• Price is about 5% under its 200-week average ($68,149) and about 11% under its 200-day average ($72,802).

**What happened (last 24h)**
• Bitcoin moved sideways around $64,000-65,000; no single cause is reported.
• The Lighter trading venue lost about $15.5M through leaked access keys, returned about 5M USDC and reopened withdrawals (PANews).
• About $487M left US spot Bitcoin funds in the latest day, and about $283M of bets on price moves were forced to close in 24 hours, on both sides (PANews, CoinGlass data).

**Short-term outlook (next 1-7 days)**
The mood is in deep fear and the next weeks lean down. The medium-term reading is in its weak zone for a second day; five days in a row would turn the headline BEARISH, around 20 November at the earliest.
• Turns up: a close above $66,750 (top of a typical week's swing), next $68,149 (200-week average).
• Sideways: between $64,150 and $66,750; a normal week swings about $3,971.
• Turns down: a close below $64,150 (30-day low).
• Rally watch: drop window open since 13 November; a rally signal needs about $79,700.
• This week: BI rate decision on Wednesday, Nvidia results and the FOMC minutes; next Fed meeting 8 December.

**News that matters**
• Lighter hack via leaked access keys, about $15.5M taken (PANews). Short term, negative.
• Strategy bought only 485 BTC last week and listed companies' net buying fell 45.2% (PANews). Medium term, small negative.
• Zelle will issue a ZelleUSD stablecoin on Solana; Western Union also uses Solana for remittances (PANews). Long term, positive.

**Altcoins & themes**
• Payment giants on Solana: Zelle, Western Union and the NYSE's owner ICE all named Solana this week (PANews); SOL is still down about 18% in 7 days.
• New on Reku: Midnight (NIGHT) is up about 19% in 7 days; the project says it moved its privacy calculations to Google Cloud, but no single reason for the move is reported.

**Bigger picture**
The next month leans down; the 3-6 month picture still leans up only barely, and is back on track only above $72,802 (200-day average).

https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Digital marketing / Paid:** Hold trader-targeted spend and keep a reserve: a Rally watch drop window is open and Bitcoin is about 5% under its 200-week average. Do not raise trader spend until a daily close back above $68,149, and a bigger push only above $72,802. Apply a d30 ROI stop-loss on running campaigns and swap price-led creatives for safety and 'learn before you trade' messages; keep rally creatives approved but not live (a rally signal needs about $79,700).

**Social media & content:** Keep the normal posting rhythm with calm, factual posts; Bitcoin is down about 12% in a week and Fear & Greed is 12. Post a plain account-safety explainer using this week's hacks (Lighter lost about $15.5M via leaked access keys, a Safe wallet lost about $6.45M, per PANews). Use Zelle's new ZelleUSD stablecoin on Solana (PANews) for a simple 'what is a stablecoin' post.

**CRM:** Reassurance and education only while the drop window is open, no deposit-bonus pushes. Send an account-safety reminder (two-factor, never share keys or codes) given the Lighter and Safe wallet incidents in the news, and a calm explainer to active holders on why Bitcoin is down about 12% in a week, with reported causes only. Keep regular lifecycle journeys running and have the next onboarding journey ready, since new sign-ups tend to arrive 2-4 weeks after a rally starts.

**SEO:** Three topics the competition is covering now (Indodax could not be read today):
• Why Bitcoin keeps falling: Pintu ran 'Kenapa Bitcoin Turun Terus?' and Pluang covered the drop under the 200-day and 200-week averages. Refresh a 'why is Bitcoin down' page; likely to draw searches with Bitcoin down about 12% in a week.
• Hacks and account safety: Pluang published four pieces on Lighter returning $5M and one on the Safe wallet loss. Publish a plain account-safety explainer.
• This week's macro calendar: Pintu previews the BI rate decision, Nvidia results and the FOMC minutes. Publish a short weekly calendar page including the 8 December Fed meeting.
Check each against Reku's pages. https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Altcoins:** Among the ten largest coins: ETH (-0.7% in 24h) — BitMine bought another 7,653 ETH and now holds close to 5% of supply (Cointelegraph on X); SOL (-1.3%) — Zelle chose Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin (PANews); HYPE (+2.1%) — after the Lighter hack, market maker Abraxas closed most of its Hyperliquid positions (Markets.xyz on X); XRP (-1.7%) — US spot XRP funds saw about $19M leave last week (PANews).
Themes: payment giants moving onto Solana, and a run of hacks at trading apps and wallets (Lighter, Safe wallet; LIT +4.6% in 24h).
New on Reku: Midnight (NIGHT, +18.7% in 7 days) says it moved its privacy calculations to Google Cloud; COTI says it opened early access to its Interphase private mode (according to the projects). PONS is down about 23% in 7 days.
